extraction.text:
Senior Network & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 6+ years of experience supporting large-scale cloudand data centre networks. Expertise in OCI networking, GPU/RDMA fabrics, SD-WAN, MPLS, and high-availability architectures. Strong hands-on experience in P1/P2 incident management, Python-basedautomation, and real-time monitoring using Grafana and Prometheus. Proven ability to operate in multi-vendor environments including Cisco, Juniper, Arista, and NVIDIACHETAN PATILJalgaon, India | cp94448@gmail.com | 9975466783 I

LinkedInSr. Network Engineer

Mar 2024 – PresentOracle INC | Sr. GNOC Engineer

Supported backend and data centre networks for NVIDIA GB200 project, enabling next-generation AIinfrastructure.

Supported and scaled backend and data centre networks for the NVIDIA GB200 AI infrastructure project,enabling next-generation GPU-based compute platforms.

Led operations and support for OCI GPU RoCE RDMA fabrics and cluster networking, delivering ultra-lowlatency, high-throughput connectivity for large-scale AI/ML workloads.

Served as primary on-call engineer, resolving 92% of P1/P2 incidents within SLA, significantly reducingdowntime and customer impact across global regions.

Led initial incident response for OCI physical networks across 50+ regions (Data Centre Fabric, Transit,Backbone, WDM), coordinating with on-site teams, ISPs, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Actively participated in P1/P2 incident bridges, performing deep-dive investigations, executingmitigations, and contributing to RCA when physical networking issues were suspected.

Designed and maintained real-time monitoring dashboards using Grafana and Prometheus, improvingvisibility, alerting, and proactive detection across global data centres.

Developed Python automation tools to analyse 5,000+ network devices, automate firmware upgrades,and streamline day-to-day network operations.

Operated and troubleshot Clos leaf–spine architectures across multi-vendor environments (Arista,Juniper, Cisco, NVIDIA), while planning and executing OS upgrades, RMAs, configuration changes.

Mentoring IC3 engineers, managers, and senior leaders on OCI network architecture and best practices.

Provided 24*7 network support services to 100+ global customers having distributed LAN/WAN setup.

Troubleshooting various issue like Node/ link down, routing, latencies, packet-loss on various type oflinks: T1/E1, T3/E3, DSL, Ethernet/MPLS & backbone links.

Worked with Telecommunication Service Providers to resolve escalated circuit problems to resolution.

Coordinating & joint troubleshooting on issues with worldwide ISPs like AT&T, XO-Verizon, Lumen:CenturyLink - Level3, Vodafone, SFR, Cogent, TATA, Airtel etc.

Worked with Hardware/Software Vendors like Cisco, Juniper, Silver Peak, etc. to resolve problems.

Day-to-day working on SDWAN technologies like Silver Peak & Cisco-Viptela. Planning & performingvarious break-fix

Activities like upgrades or RMA of various network devices in stipulated timeframe.

Managed the firmware upgrade of Silver Peak Orchestrator and 1500 SDWAN devices, minimizingdowntime and ensuring network stability.

Created SOP documents for L1 engineers, improving efficiency in handling Silver Peak deployments andupgrades.Oct 2021 – Feb 2024NTT Global Networks Limited | Engineer - Network OperationsPROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Juniper Certified Network Associate (JNCIA)

Fortinet NSE-1

Fortinet NSE-2

Silver Peak SDWAN certification-SPSX

Oracle Cloud Foundations Associate.

CERTIFICATIONS

TECHNICAL SKILLS NetworkingRDMA, RoCE, OSI Model, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN/MAN, VLANs, Switching,Routing, Subnetting, VPN (L2/L3, VPLS, IPSEC),EVPN, VXLAN, HighAvailability (HSRP,VRRP, GLBP), L2/L3 Security, Network Security, Layer2/3 Troubleshooting, Connectivity, Bandwidth & Latency Optimization.Network ProtocolsARP, ICMP, IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL, VTP,ACLs, STP, RSTP, MSTP, 802.1x, SNMP, VRFs, RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, IS-IS,BGP.Platform ToolsCisco,Juniper, Huawei, ALU, Wireshark, GNS3, Cisco Packet Tracer, Putty,Grafana, Prometheus, Git, ServiceNow. Automation & ScriptingPython, Bash, Linux, Ansible

Experienced in troubleshooting ILL, VPN, L2VPN, L3VPN, and MPLS networks for managed andunmanaged customers, resolving link-down issues, packet loss, latency, duplex mismatches, bandwidthutilization, and site reachability problems.

Strong expertise in diagnosing and resolving routing issues across OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, and static routingenvironments.

Hands-on experience configuring, hardening, and maintaining Cisco, Juniper, Huawei, and ALU routersand switches, including IOS and license upgrades and LAN/VLAN management.

Proven ability to coordinate with multiple service providers (Bharti, TTSL, Vodafone, Airtel, TTML, RailTel,Verizon, SLT, XO, TE DATA) under strict SLA commitments.

Skilled in managing customer incidents and escalations, providing timely updates, sharing technical logs,and delivering RCA/RFO reports via email and NGP portals.Mar 2019 - Jun 2020Lobo Staffing Solutions ( Client TATA Communications Limited) | Network Engineer

Provided L1/L2 technical support for managed services customers in a 24x7 NOC environment.

Monitored and resolved network and security alerts, including Sentinel One endpoint protectionincidents.

Investigated Azure Risk Watch events and malicious email threats, ensuring timely mitigation andreporting.

Supported escalation handling, shift rostering, and operational continuity for global support teams.June 2020 – Oct 2021ConnectWise (Formerly Continuum Managed Solutions) | Technical Engineer
